title: Remove stale CI skip guard from jsfl.spec.ts
description:
apps/desktop/e2e/jsfl.spec.ts line 3 has: test.skip(!!process.env.CI, 'skip until fully wired')

This skip was added before the JSFL bridge was implemented. Task 0097 (JSFL scripting subset) is now done and all 3 JSFL tests pass locally. The skip guard is stale and will silently suppress all JSFL e2e tests the moment any CI environment is wired up.

Fix: remove line 3 entirely. Then verify the three JSFL tests still pass:
  cd apps/desktop && pnpm e2e -- e2e/jsfl.spec.ts

The visual-oracle skip (visual-oracle.spec.ts line 178) is intentional — Ruffle WASM is not yet set up for CI — and should be left in place.
